title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a web interface and CLI for semantic search, faceted filtering, and AI agent integration via MCP.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for serving data, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or deploy to AWS.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search across repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
MCP server integration for AI agents like Claude Code
Static web UI with autocomplete and shareable URLs
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
